units.source_text: 这时候朝鲜派使臣来朝觐了，其中有一个高明的相士。

en.t: Around this time, Korea sent envoys to pay homage at court, and among them was a highly skilled physiognomist.

units.source_text: 皇上闻此消息，想召见这相士，教他替小皇子看相。

en.t: When the Emperor heard this news, he wished to summon the physiognomist and have him read the young prince's features.

units.source_text: 但宇多天皇定下禁例：外国人不得入宫。

en.t: But Emperor Uda had established a prohibition: foreigners were not allowed to enter the palace.

units.source_text: 他只得悄悄地派小皇子到招待外宾的鸿胪馆去访问这相士。

en.t: He therefore had no choice but to send the young prince quietly to visit the physiognomist at the Korokan, where foreign guests were received.

units.source_text: 一个官居右大弁的朝臣是小皇子的保护人，

en.t: A courtier holding the post of Right Controller was the young prince's guardian,

units.source_text: 皇上教小皇子扮作这右大弁的儿子，一同前往。

en.t: and the Emperor had the young prince disguise himself as this Right Controller's son and go with him.

units.source_text: 相士看了小皇子的相貌，大为吃惊，几度侧首仔细端详，不胜诧异。

en.t: When the physiognomist saw the young prince's features, he was greatly startled; several times he tilted his head and studied him closely, unable to hide his astonishment.

units.source_text: 后来说道：“照这位公子的相貌看来，应该当一国之王，登至尊之位。

en.t: At length he said, "Judging from this young lord's features, he ought to become the ruler of a nation and ascend to the highest rank.

units.source_text: 然而若果如此，深恐国家发生变乱，己身遭逢忧患。

en.t: Yet if that were to happen, I deeply fear that the realm would fall into turmoil and that he himself would meet with sorrow and misfortune.

units.source_text: 若是当朝廷柱石，辅佐天下政治呢，则又与相貌不合。”

en.t: On the other hand, if he were merely to become a pillar of the court and assist in governing the realm, that too would not match his appearance."

units.source_text: 这右大弁原是个富有才艺的博士，

en.t: This Right Controller was originally a scholar richly endowed with talent and accomplishments,

units.source_text: 和这相士高谈阔论，颇感兴味。

en.t: and he found great interest in conversing at length with the physiognomist.

units.source_text: 两人吟诗作文，互相赠答。

en.t: The two composed poems and prose, exchanging them with one another.

units.source_text: 相士即日就要告辞返国。

en.t: The physiognomist was to take his leave and return to his country that very day.

units.source_text: 他此次得见如此相貌不凡之人物，深感欣幸；

en.t: He felt deeply fortunate to have met on this visit a person of such extraordinary appearance;

units.source_text: 如今即将离别，反觉不胜悲伤。

en.t: but now that they were about to part, he found himself overcome with sadness.

units.source_text: 他作了许多咏他此种心情的优美的诗文，

en.t: He composed many beautiful poems and writings expressing these feelings,

units.source_text: 赠与小皇子。

en.t: and presented them to the young prince.

units.source_text: 小皇子也吟成非常可爱之诗篇，作为报答。

en.t: The young prince too composed a most charming poem in return.

units.source_text: 相士读了小皇子的诗，大加赞赏，

en.t: When the physiognomist read the young prince's poem, he praised it highly,

units.source_text: 奉赠种种珍贵礼品。

en.t: and respectfully offered him various precious gifts.

units.source_text: 朝廷也重重赏赐这相士。

en.t: The court also bestowed generous rewards on the physiognomist.

units.source_text: 此事虽然秘而不宣，但世人早已传闻。

en.t: Although this affair was kept secret and not publicly announced, people had already heard rumors of it.

units.source_text: 太子的外祖父右大臣等闻知此事，

en.t: When the Minister of the Right, the Crown Prince's maternal grandfather, and the others learned of this matter,

units.source_text: 深恐皇上有改立太子之心，顿生疑忌。

en.t: they deeply feared that the Emperor meant to replace the Crown Prince, and at once grew suspicious and resentful.
